hero.title: A playground for both crafts.
hero.sub: Interactive, game-like experiments from both sides of what I do — spot a phishing email, then build a cocktail. Made to be poked at, not just read. More toys land here over time.

zones.hint: use the mode toggle to focus

soon.title: More experiments incoming.
soon.sub: Next up: a 'spot the vulnerability' challenge, a few security puzzles and more bar games. Both crafts get their own toys here.

builder.title: Build a drink, the Cocktail Tree way.
builder.sub: Six roots, six iconic families. Pick a base spirit and pour its signature serve.

game.title: Spot the phish.
game.sub: Six emails. Phishing or legit? Trust your gut — then see the red flags.
game.finishSub: Spotting these is a daily habit — the same instinct I bring to the code I ship.

vault.title: Crack the vault.
vault.sub: Type a password and watch a cracker estimate how long it takes to break — against four kinds of attacker. Nothing is stored or sent.
vault.privacy: 100% local — your keystrokes never leave this page.
vault.win: Vault sealed — that would outlast a GPU farm for over a century. 🔒

guess.title: Guess the cocktail.
guess.sub: Read the spec and name the classic. How's your palate?
guess.question: Which classic is this?

shake.title: Shake or stir?
shake.sub: Citrus, juice or egg gets shaken; all-spirit gets stirred. Trust your hands.

pour.title: Pour-cost lab.
pour.sub: The real consultancy maths — enter the numbers, watch the margins. Pour cost under ~20% keeps a bar alive.
pour.note: Pour cost = (bottle price × pour ÷ bottle size) ÷ sell price.

spirit.title: Name that spirit.
spirit.sub: Distillation, botanicals and origins — how deep does your bar knowledge run?

forge.title: Hash forge.
forge.sub: Type anything and watch it hash live across SHA-1/256/512 — real crypto, in your browser. Flip one bit and the whole digest scrambles.
forge.note: Highlighted nibbles changed since the last keystroke — the avalanche effect. Nothing leaves this page.

cipher.title: Cipher lab.
cipher.sub: Every hidden message is a cocktail recipe. Slide the wheel to find the Caesar shift and decrypt it.
